logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was measured by determining their partition coefficients (log Po/w) between n-octanol (o) and water (w) using the shake-flask method. (67) A calibration plot for the complex was constructed by determining the absorbances by varying complex concentrations in the aqueous medium containing 1% DMSO. Then, the known concentration of the aqueous solution of the complex containing 1% DMSO was prepared and mixed with an equal volume of n-octanol. After vortex-shaking the mixture, the two phases were allowed to separate. The concentration of the complex in the aqueous phase was then determined from the calibration plot. The partition coefficient was calculated by using the equation log Po/w = log[complex]oct/[complex]aq, where [complex]oct is the concentration of the complex in the n-octanol phase and [complex]aq is the concentration in the aqueous phase.
